_comment: Timing units for the common combinational modules (rtl/common/), for tools/check-ngd.py: one module at one parameterisation each. ccv_common_csa is an inner helper, timed in its parents; held alone, NGD-6's 16 caps it, so its unit is 6 operands (3 compressor levels and the add, TI's response OI-76); ooe_freelist's instance times the 16-group form.
